title: Merge from the Test run itself the moment the required checks are green; cut the slow invariant and compile steps
goal: push-to-merge under 60s: the merge no longer waits for the whole Test run (workflow_run fires after the slowest job, Repository Invariants at 110s, which the ruleset does not even require); the verdict check and the compile check lose their fixed overheads; the queue relay client stops paying a round trip per lease
